title: Tuba or bass at Jazz Limited, and twelve years there

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, you were playing tuba and string bass? Weren't you?
And you were featured on 'Tiger Rag' and 'Asleep in the Deep'?
Did you have any preference of which instrument you played with Reinhart?
With Reinhart the tuba went better than the string bass, on account of the New Orleans tempos.
Or the attempts at New Orleans tempos.
Slow, lazy, two-beat things. Tuba went better.
How long were you at Jazz Limited?
Did that band play very much on the road?
No, very seldom. Every now and then we might make a trip, little short trip like up to Michigan, or something, you know, on the holiday for one night. Right back to Chicago.
And I know it made one album on Atlantic, Reinhart's band, that you were on.
No, that's the only one I made.
